Selective reload is the member this task most invites and most deliberately excludes: it turns 'apply what is written down' into 'apply what this document says', which is a much wider authority than a reload should carry.
Unknown top-level member — `force`. There is no validation to skip; a flag suggesting otherwise would be implemented by someone who did not check.
Unknown top-level member — `config`. Inline configuration would let a producer put the agent into a state its own configuration does not describe, with no record of it anywhere but this request.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced. Worth pinning on a payload whose only permitted member is ext.
